# How many employees does CoLab Software have?

Colab Software, Inc. has approximately275 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.CoLab Software’s total headcount has grown214.0% from 87 employees in 2023 to 275 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is CoLab Software hiring right now?

Yes, CoLab Software isactively hiring. CoLab Software had74 active job postings in 2026, a 128.9% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/colab-software/employees#postings).

## About CoLab Software’s Workforce

CoLab Software, Inc. is an Information Technology Services company that employs **275** people worldwide as of June 2026. It is the 8th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/colab-software/employees#similar-companies). Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in St. John's, Canada.

CoLab Software's workforce has grown **214.0%** from 2023 to 2026, up **16.7%** year over year in 2026. Its workforce is concentrated most in North America ( **90.8%**), followed by South Asia ( **3.7%**) and Northern Europe ( **3.3%**).

CoLab Software's groups are Finance and Operations ( **35.8%**), Engineering ( **32.1%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **32.1%**), with Engineering growing fastest (up **33.4%**). The average salary is **$102,493,** ranging from a median of **$90,000** in North America to **$6,000** in South Asia, up **7.0%** year over year in 2026.

CoLab Software's active job postings rose **128.9%** in 2026 to **74**, with new postings per month climbing from **3** in 2023 to **24** in 2026. Overall employee sentiment is positive and improving.
